title: Get the ultimate security for your MacBook by changing these privacy settings

claims.claim: MacBook üzerinde parolanızı değiştirmek için System Settings > Lock Screen yolu izlenebilir.

evidence.quote: To tweak these settings, go to System Settings > Lock Screen.

claims.claim: Konum Servisleri ayarlarına Settings, ardindan Privacy & Security adimlari takip edilerek ulasilabilir.

evidence.quote: If you go to Settings, then Privacy & Security, you'll find Location Services.

claims.claim: MacBook uzerindeki Firewall secenegi varsayilan olarak kapali gelmektedir.

evidence.quote: your MacBook comes with a Firewall option that's off by default.
On the topic of exercising control, your MacBook comes with a Firewall option that's off by default.

claims.claim: Firewall ozelligini acmak icin System Settings > Network > Firewall adimlari izlenebilir.

evidence.quote: To turn it on, you can go to System Settings > Network > Firewall.

claims.claim: Apple, App Store veya Apple News gibi alanlarda reklam sunmak icin veri toplar.

evidence.quote: Apple, among others, collects data on you that it uses to serve you ads in spots like the App Store or Apple News.

claims.claim: Kisisellestirilmis Reklamlar kapatildiginda Apple'in ilgili reklam sunma yetenegi sinirlenir ancak gorulen reklam sayisi degismez.

evidence.quote: A note on the settings page says this limits "Apple's ability to deliver relevant ads," but it does not impact how many ads you see.

claims.claim: Analitik verileri bir ay sonra silinmektedir.

evidence.quote: Your analytics data then gets deleted after a month.

claims.claim: Analitik verilerini paylasimini kapatmak icin Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics Improvements adimlari izlenebilir.

evidence.quote: you can go to Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics Improvements and toggle off several choices like Improve Siri & Dictation and Share with App Developers.

If you'd just rather not take the risk, you can go to Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics Improvements and toggle off several choices like Improve Siri & Dictation and Share with App Developers.
